description: Wait for the Mockzilla workflow run to finish and return the live mock URL, as the action printed it in the run's log. Mockzilla picks the host when the deploy runs, so this is the one place to get it. Call after `publish_to_github`, or after the user pushes. A first deploy takes a minute or two. If it returns with no conclusion it ran out of time: call again.
name: wait_for_github_deploy
